style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks.

source.scene: Inspect the named asset collection; do not use an unrelated active scene

preserve: Every logical frame/root/sourceScale and per-clip/direction override
Original footprint, height/proportions, sockets, ports, rigs and projection
Every registered clip, facing, frame count and fps/loop behavior
Lighting without preferred horizontal direction for rotatable world objects; no directional ground cast shadow
Actual independent geometry views and native animation; no raster card or per-view image fitting/recolor

judgeMeasuredRequirements.requirement: Preserve actual original asymmetric faceted slate mass, one-cell ground envelope and 0.48 height/proportions. Preserve fine shallow top fissure and its orientation with the model. No target-driven silhouette enlargement or replacement by a generic pebble.

Preserve exact registered camera/projection/pixel aspect, root, scale and frame. Capture is 384x704; logical frame [192,352], root [96,248], sourceScale 2, cellSize 128. No per-view fitting, cropping, stretching or recolor.
Render actual independent geometry at N/E/S/W for static frame 0; one frame per view, 12 fps metadata, static true, loop false. Supply four-view-sheet and repeated previews.
Use soft light with no preferred horizontal direction for the rotatable object and no directional ground cast shadow. Preserve clean real transparency.

Supply editable native Blender source, hash-bound packet, native camera/root/bounds/height/footprint/geometry/light evidence and declared resources. No raster card, image warping or painted render substitutions.

aestheticGoals.success: The irregular broad crown, sloped perimeter and substantial side depth remain readable at the logical game scale. The asymmetrical original silhouette and uneven crown remain; small soft edge responses may improve tactility without smoothing away the source facets.
aestheticGoals.reject: Round pebble silhouette, changed footprint/height, new platform, excessive inflated bevels, lost crown/side distinction, or new protruding chips.

aestheticGoals.success: Dominant color remains subdued slate blue-gray. Gentle neutral-to-warm gray highlight variation gives the requested welcoming cartoon feel while still reading as the source slate material.
aestheticGoals.reject: A beige/tan crown dominates, highly saturated blue, washed-out white patches, or near-black lower planes that merge into unreadable mass.

aestheticGoals.success: Broad soft diffuse light reveals crown, side facets and lower edge without crushed shadows. Highlight response is restrained and matte; rotation reveals geometry while preserving the same soft tonal family.
aestheticGoals.reject: A baked lateral spotlight, left-right directional rim, strong shiny streaks, blown crown, directional ground shadow or a dead black base band.

aestheticGoals.success: A restrained, stable low-frequency variation helps the broad slate facets feel tactile and softly cartoon-rendered. The fine shallow fissure remains legible and attached to the crown, with visual weight close to its original identity.
aestheticGoals.reject: Dense grain, glitter, stippled/painterly noise, arbitrary triangulation bands, deep or enlarged target-like slot, sharp white crack rim or apparent floating fissure.

aestheticGoals.success: All four native views are clean at native and logical size against light, gray and dark backgrounds. No clipping, z-fighting, pinholes, halos, broken corners, disconnected crack, seam bands or muddy merged planes. Repeated placements retain consistent weight and style.
aestheticGoals.reject: Any material defect or a view that only looks acceptable when enlarged; overlaid contact shadows or texture changes that do not follow the model.

delivery.scope: Refine this object only. Root coordinator promotes approved atlases, sources and metadata to production, publishes the PR preview, and finally updates Godot.
delivery.notes: Write source/round-NN.blend or the actual native 2D source as appropriate; full native captures, original-layout atlases, previews, validation and delivery.json. Do not label 2D artwork as a Blender model.
